theorems.name: Submission.adr_null_open_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < ℓ → μH[ℓ] E = 0 → 0 < ε → ∃ U : ℕ → Set (Euclid P), (∀ j, IsOpen (U j)) ∧ E ⊆ ⋃ j, U j ∧ ∑' j, Metric.ediam (U j) ^ ℓ < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
